setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step pattern, C3 D3 E3 F3 (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) at velocities 127, 117, 107 and 97, in C major through the test MIDI device at 90 BPM with Rate /1 and channel range steps 1-4. The sequencer is stopped and the Device page for CH01 is showing. Channel 2 is not set up yet: you will make it a steady timing reference. Trigless locks is at its default On.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap K1 and open PARAMS > MOSAIC, select Trigless locks and turn E3 left to Off. The row reads Off.
steps.title: Turn Trigless locks off

steps.caption: Press K2, then K1 to leave the menu. Set up channel 2 as the timing reference: tap (2,1), open Channel tasks > Device, point it at the second MIDI port, give it pattern 1 at (1,2) and range steps 1-4 (hold (1,4), tap (4,4)). It will play C D E F on MIDI channel 2 on every loop whatever you do to channel 1. Then tap channel 1 (1,1), open Channel tasks > Trig params and assign CC 1 to the first slot.
steps.title: Assign CC 1

steps.caption: Press K3 to confirm CC 1 and K2 to go back. Hold step 1 and turn E3 to 24. Slot 1 shows 24 with an L in its corner while the step is held. Release the step.
steps.title: Lock step 1 to 24

steps.caption: Do the same on the other steps. Hold step 2 and turn E3 to 48, hold step 3 for 72 and hold step 4 for 96. Slot 1 reads 96 with the L while step 4 is held, so every step now carries its own CC 1 value.
steps.title: Lock steps 2 to 4 to 48, 72 and 96

steps.caption: Assign Trig probability to the second slot, so you can silence channel 1's notes and see only its CC 1 stream beside channel 2's steady notes.
steps.title: Add Trig probability

steps.caption: Set Trig probability to 0 so channel 1's notes never sound, and play two loops. All four steps still have trigs, so CC 1 still goes out at every step (24, 48, 72, 96) even with Trigless locks Off: look for those four CC values each loop in the MIDI strip, beside channel 2's steady notes. A probability of 0 is not a rest: only a removed trig is.
steps.title: Probability 0 silences the notes, not the locks

steps.caption: Open the Pattern editor (5,8), tap step 3 to remove its trig, and return to the Channel editor (3,8). Play. With Trigless locks Off, a lock on a step with no trig is skipped: the MIDI strip shows CC 1 sending 24, 48 and 96 but not 72, the value on step 3.
steps.title: Remove the third trig

steps.caption: Hold step 4 and turn E3 to set its Trig probability lock to 100, then play. Step 4's note (F3, 65) now sounds, with its CC 1 lock (96) sent just before it. Steps 1 and 2 stay silent, and step 3 still sends no value. The scene Keep automation on rests plays the same steps with Trigless locks On, for comparison.
steps.title: Keep a lock ahead of its accepted note
